svg.title: Canadian veterinary spending and the estimate questions
svg.desc: The Competition Bureau page dated 30 Oct 2024 states that Canadians spent 9.3 billion dollars on veterinary services in 2023. The 2019 figure on that page is described as almost 4 billion dollars and is not drawn as an exact bar. The four steps are questions to ask, not a statute.
svg.text: Competition Bureau, 30 Oct 2024. The 2019 line on that page says almost $4 billion and is not drawn.

g.text: Drug charges separate from the professional fee
Written prescription if you want to compare a fill
Follow the plan you accept. A missing option is not a discount.

svg.text: Ontario rules opened 26 Sep 2026: Regulation 1093 itemized account on request, and section 26 for the prescription.
Bar length is illustrative of one stated figure, not a time series. No second bar for an imprecise 2019 number.
